name: @tred/video
description: Vidéos promotionnelles de TRED, rendues avec Remotion à partir des vrais composants de packages/web.

scripts.render:series: for c in EN-1-Beyond-Engineering EN-2-Universal-Tutor EN-3-Future-of-Learning DE-1-Jura-Medizin DE-2-Wirtschaft-Technik DE-3-Alle-Faecher; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/$c.mp4 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18; done
scripts.voiceover:cine: node scripts/voiceover.mjs k && node scripts/voiceover.mjs b
scripts.render:v4: for c in V4-EN-1-The-Research V4-EN-2-The-Workflow V4-EN-3-The-Expansion V4-DE-1-Die-Altklausur-Suche V4-DE-2-Deep-Work V4-DE-3-Die-Fachschaft; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/campaign-v4/$c.mp4 --concurrency=1 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18; done
scripts.render:demo: for c in D1-EN-The-Workflow D1-DE-Der-Workflow D2-EN-The-Schemas D2-DE-Die-Schemata D3-EN-The-Video-Feature D3-DE-Das-Video-Feature D4-EN-Interactive-Learning D4-DE-Interaktives-Lernen D5-EN-The-Dashboard D5-DE-Das-Dashboard; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/campaign-v3/$c.mp4 --concurrency=1 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18; done
scripts.render:campaign: for c in C1-EN-Lets-Be-Real C1-DE-Seien-Wir-Ehrlich C2-EN-Professor-Who-Gets-You C2-DE-Professor-Der-Dich-Versteht C3-EN-Zero-Guessing C3-DE-Nicht-Geraten C4-EN-Exam-In-Two-Days C4-DE-Klausur-In-Zwei-Tagen C5-EN-The-Vibe C5-DE-Der-Vibe; do remotion render src/index.ts $c out/campaign/$c.mp4 --concurrency=1 --scale=2 --codec=h264 --crf=18; done
